Plus, from the same thread: let Settings rename/remove a booking category (rename rewrites meetings.category), since no such editor exists today (Settings only has "+ Add New" for vocab and a Category Billing card).

No version bump anywhere (index.html ?v=, sw.js CACHE_VERSION/PRECACHE_URLS, js/consts.js APP_VERSION untouched). CHANGELOG bullets go under a new '## [Unreleased]' heading placed above '## [1.11.0] — 2026-09-12'. test/unit/versions.test.js matches only '## [x.y.z] — date' headings, so the Unreleased heading does not break it.

Tags are stored exactly like projects.tags: a comma-joined TEXT column, normalized on save via one shared helper UI.parseTags (split on comma, trim, drop empties, dedupe exact-match, preserve order) and UI.joinTags. Every reader (views, reports, exports) splits with UI.parseTags — never GROUP BY tags in SQL.

'Vocab-backed' = tag suggestions come from DB.vocabList('BOOKING_TAG') (custom rows in the vocab table; CONST has no BOOKING_TAG key, and vocabList already tolerates that by returning only custom rows) unioned with distinct tags already on meetings; each tag saved on a booking is also DB.addVocab('BOOKING_TAG', tag)'d so the vocabulary grows. No consts.js change.

Report rules mirror js/reports.js: exclude is_cancelled=1 entirely; hours = UI.hoursBetween(start_time,end_time); a booking with N tags counts once under each of its N tags (documented in the card footnote and the XLSX Notes sheet as deliberate repetition, same disclosure style as the activitymix entity).

Category rename/remove lives in the existing Settings 'Category Billing' card (views.js settings(), ~line 1491), one Rename and one Remove control per category row. Rename rewrites meetings.category and category_policies.category (PK collision = merge: target row wins, old row dropped, like DB.renameOrganization). Remove is offered only when zero meetings carry the category. Built-ins live in CONST.BOOKING_CATEGORY and cannot be deleted from a table, so a renamed/removed built-in is recorded in an app_config key 'hidden_vocab_BOOKING_CATEGORY' (JSON array) that DB.vocabList filters out. The three built-ins that code keys on — 'consult' (Reports Consults card, funnel, breadth), 'training' and 'assisted session' (category_policies follow_assisted link, Settings row special-casing) — are refused for rename/remove with a sentence-case toast naming why.

extend the card's help text with one sentence-case sentence: 'Renaming a category updates every booking that uses it; a category can only be removed once no booking uses it. consult, training and assisted session are built into the reports and billing rules and cannot be renamed or removed.' app.js: add `case 'category-rename': return renameCategoryFromSettings(el.dataset.category);` and `case 'category-remove': return removeCategoryFromSettings(el.dataset.category);` INSIDE the `// Bookings (Meetings) CRUD` block of handleAct (after `case 'bom-group-apply'`, before `// Custom KV Fields CRUD`) — never at the end of the switch. `renameCategoryFromSettings(cat)`: UI.openModal with title 'Rename Category', an input `#cat-rename-to` prefilled with cat, a body sentence `This renames the category on every booking that uses it (N bookings).` using DB.countBookingCategoryRefs, footer Cancel (`data-act="close"`) + primary button wired via onMount `m.querySelector('#cat-rename-go').onclick` (an id-based onclick, not a new data-act) that calls DB.renameBookingCategory, toasts `Category renamed on N bookings` (or the merge variant), closes, refresh(). `removeCategoryFromSettings(cat)`: if refs > 0 toast 'This category is still used by N bookings — rename it instead.' and return; else `await UI.confirmModal('Remove Category', `Remove "${cat}" from the category list?`, { danger: true, confirmText: 'Remove' })`, then DB.removeBookingCategory, toast, refresh(). Title Case for button titles/dialog titles, sentence case for body/toasts.

risks.risk: The worktree's git index has every tracked file staged as deleted (files still on disk). An executor that commits without noticing wipes the repo in the commit; one that runs `git reset --hard` loses nothing now but would destroy uncommitted work later.
risks.mitigation: First step of T1/T2: `git reset` (mixed) at 4f5214e, then `git status --short` must be empty before editing. Commit after every task; never use --hard.

risks.risk: A meetings ALTER placed before the meetings_new rebuild in migrate() is silently dropped (the rebuild copies an explicit column list), so an upgraded database would lack tags while a fresh one has it.
risks.mitigation: T2 pins the block at the very end of migrate() and its verification checks the fence's line number is after 'RENAME TO meetings' and after the project_outputs block; T9 tests the extracted ALTER against a raw table.

risks.risk: Adding a Tags header without the value at the same index (or forgetting the matching !cols entry) shifts every later column in an XLSX sheet, including money columns — the exact class of export-only defect the lessons file records surviving review.
risks.mitigation: T6's verification reads the real SheetJS workbook and looks up values by header name; it also checks 'Charged Total' is still the last Bookings & Costs header, and T9 keeps that as a standing test.

risks.risk: Counting tags by GROUP BY on the comma-joined column would treat 'SIM, Fiji' as one tag; or a second hours formula drifting from UI.hoursBetween.
risks.mitigation: T5 splits in JS with the shared UI.parseTags and uses UI.hoursBetween; verification asserts the GROUP BY count in reports.js is unchanged and the 2-tag booking case yields the expected per-tag rows.

risks.risk: Renaming 'consult' / 'training' / 'assisted session' breaks the Consults card, funnel, breadth and the category-billing follow link, which key on those literal strings.
risks.mitigation: T7 refuses rename/remove for the protected trio at the DB layer and T8 hides the controls for them; the Settings help text says so in plain language.

risks.mitigation: T8 owns both files in one task, places the cases inside the '// Bookings (Meetings) CRUD' block, and its verification greps the line-number order and runs the unit suite.

risks.mitigation: T8 is scheduled in its own later batch and depends on T3 and T4.
